description: the target cylinder of cross-cylinders-common minus the tool: πR²L − 16R³/3 of material in two lumps, above and below the tool, which is as wide as the target. The two lumps' closures meet at the crossing vertices (0, ±R, 0), where the walls touch: two shells sharing a vertex, which a manifold solid does not hold — Arris refuses with OpError::Degenerate and Reason::NonManifold naming them, Open CASCADE builds a compound of two solids (ADR-0006; plans/cylinder-cylinder-booleans step 2)
